triples.tail_surface: Observe the density information in the order documentation
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 遵守订单文件中的密度信息
triples.evidence_text:
Too high density of the fluid pumped could lead to motor overload, which could damage
the motor.

Observe the density information in the order documentation.

triples.tail_surface: Make sure that the motor has sufficient power reserves
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 确保电机具有足够的功率储备
triples.evidence_text:
Too high density of the fluid pumped could lead to motor overload, which could damage
the motor.

Make sure that the motor has sufficient power reserves.

triples.head_surface: formation of deposits within the pump and the pump intake area
triples.head_canonical_zh: 泵及吸入区沉积物形成
triples.tail_surface: Start up the pump (set) regularly between once a month and once every three months for approximately five minutes during prolonged shutdown periods
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 长期停机期间每月至每三个月定期启动泵组约五分钟
triples.evidence_text:
Start up the pump (set) regularly between once a month and once every three months for
approximately five minutes during prolonged shutdown periods. This will prevent the formation
of deposits within the pump and the pump intake area.

triples.tail_surface: Spray-coat the inside wall of the pumpcasing, and in particular the impeller clearance areas, with a preservative
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 用防腐剂喷涂泵壳内壁特别是叶轮间隙区域
triples.evidence_text:
Spray-coat the inside wall of the pumpcasing, and in particular the impeller clearance areas,
with a preservative.

triples.tail_surface: Spray the preservative through the suction and discharge nozzles
triples.tail_canonical_zh: 通过吸入和排出喷嘴喷涂防腐剂
triples.evidence_text: Spray the preservative through the suction and discharge nozzles.
